authorizedRoute.safeHumanAction: Submit an asset-free inquiry asking for Northside Radio's current airplay-submission process after rechecking live validation and anti-spam controls.

businessContact.verification: No purpose-bound public music-submission email was observed on the reviewed official pages. The first-party Music-category form was verified as the authorized public inquiry route. No address was guessed, decoded or substituted, and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.

formAssessment.liveValidationOrAntiSpamState: not fully exposed in passive rendering; must be rechecked manually

activityVerification.evidence: The official homepage exposes Listen Live, Program Guide, Listen Again, Song History and News surfaces and an active station-support campaign.

genreFitEvidence: The public station navigation exposes an active programme guide and song-history surface
The Music category establishes an authorized route for a policy inquiry
Electronic, dance, soul, funk, jazz, blues, Latin and world programming are plausible catalogue-fit areas, subject to programme-level confirmation
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The first-party form has a Music subject but does not expressly authorize unsolicited audio delivery or disclose accepted files or links, metadata, release timing, international eligibility, explicit-content rules or AI-origin policy. A human must inspect the current form for validation, privacy and anti-spam controls, use it only for an asset-free process inquiry and avoid sending music or private links unless Northside confirms an authorized route.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: The complete open-pull-request patch was searched for both station names, canonical domains, Eastside's purpose-specific mailbox and Northside's Contact path. No prior music-submission-agent opportunity or queue record was found for either station.
deduplication.consolidation: Eastside's Music enquiries mailbox is stored once; its separate general, Music Interviews, programming, reviews, arts and show contacts are excluded. Northside's Music subject and enquiry form are stored as one route; other subject categories and the published street address are not counted as music-submission methods.

notes: Two new free-first, first-party inquiry routes were queued. Both remain needs_manual_review because neither official page currently authorizes direct audio delivery or publishes complete submission requirements. No outbound action was taken.
